project.name: Brix Infra Adapter - Kafka (Aggregator)
project.description:
Kafka EventBus Adapter Aggregator Module (Open Source)
This aggregator module contains two sub-modules: - infra-adapter-kafka-core: Core Kafka EventBusCapability implementation - infra-adapter-kafka-outbox: Outbox transactional event publishing extension (requires JPA)
Architecture Notes: The Outbox pattern naturally depends on Kafka publishing capability, so it is placed as a sub-module of Kafka, following the "composition over isolation" pragmatic design principle. Consumers can include as needed: - Kafka only: include infra-adapter-kafka-core - With Outbox: include infra-adapter-kafka-outbox (transitively includes core)
Architecture Layer: Layer 2.5 - Adapter Layer (Open Source)
